mechanism_1_mkl.description: Convex combination of Hilbert space kernels: K = beta * K_quant + (1-beta) * K_rbf

mechanism_2_decision_fusion.description: Calibrated Softmax probability blending: P = alpha * P_quant + (1-alpha) * P_rbf

bias_mitigation.conclusion: Classical model suffered from 16% false negatives on Wheat (biased toward Maize). Quantum model restored balance. Hybrid achieves >=90% recall on every single crop.
